name: power-input-jst
title: 5 V input: JST PH connector, reverse-polarity diode, capacitor
about: Two-wire supply input as in the edakit example: JST PH 2-pin connector, SS34 Schottky diode against reverse polarity (drops 0.3–0.5 V), 22 µF behind it.

components.label: {as}: 22 µF at the input
components.notes: X5R: at 5 V only about 30–50 % of the 22 µF are left (DC bias).

nets.name: vin
nets.notes: Connector side of the diode; for another supply voltage change v here and on the output.

notes: Graph: add the connector to checks.reverse_protect – G-10 then checks that a reversed plug reaches only the diode's anode.
sim.json: the connector under sources (plus "1", minus "2") and its voltages under supplies.
The 22 µF ceramic is the buffer of the example; for long cables or plugging in while powered add an electrolytic (hint H-1).
